metrics.raw: candidate linearly interpolated onto the reference abscissae inside the overlap; no alignment
metrics.aligned: best x shift (characteristic curves only, ±2.5 in 0.005 steps) plus mean y offset removed; RMS after alignment
metrics.exact_x_match_fraction: fraction of candidate abscissae within 1e-4 of a reference abscissa
metrics.profile_note: profile arrays are re-gridded, D-min subtracted and renormalized by spektrafilm, so only 'aligned' is meaningful against 'profile'

derived_rule: flag derived_from_spektrafilm when raw RMS against legacy < max(stated digitization error, 0.01) with exact_x_match_fraction >= 0.9
